wisdomClassModifiers.scope: Multiply only the named Wisdom conversion, not flat gear/skill bonuses. Healer uses standard Wisdom conversion; other classes only specified targets.

intelligenceAttackClassModifiers.scope: Only magical attack contributed by Intelligence. Druid/Herbalist +5%; all other classes standard, including Luminet/Ritualist/Healer.

vitalityClassModifiers.scope: All three Vitality conversions; does not multiply flat HP, defense or regeneration bonuses.

strengthAttackClassModifiers.scope: Only the physical attack conversion of Strength; Penetration is unchanged. Classes not eligible for Strength attack still receive zero attack.

specialAttributeProgression.source: Existing skill grants retained; socket sources and progression not implemented.
specialAttributeProgression.balanceNote: Compare attainable attribute totals and opportunity costs; identical thresholds or factors do not imply equal benefit.

weaponCalculationRules.twoHandedWeaponRule: Use the stored two-handed weapon stats once; no off-hand reduction.

conversions.note: Penetration rating counters Block rating. Neither is a direct percentage; no fixed 100 percent Block stat. Exact counter-formula remains pending.
Adds 0.06 percentage points per Agility, equivalent to 0.0006 of base attack speed.
Increases critical hit probability through the still pending rating formula; not a direct percentage bonus.
Earlier tentative attribution; latest confirmed mana conversion is Wisdom -> 30 Mana. Do not apply Intelligence-to-Mana unless separately confirmed.

criticalHitRules.scope: All characters start with an 80 percent additional damage bonus on a critical hit.

offensiveAttributeEligibility.activation: Internal class calculation, not a learnable skill; no SP cost or additional skill count.
offensiveAttributeEligibility.targetRule: Use the attack target defined by the attribute conversion; this rule changes its factor, not its damage type.
offensiveAttributeEligibility.scope: Only attack conversion; other effects such as Dexterity accuracy or skill-granted Mana remain unchanged.
offensiveAttributeEligibility.precedence: An explicit skill or class conversion overrides the matching/non-matching default and replaces that attack conversion without stacking.

overrideRule.description: An explicit class or skill conversion replaces the default conversion of the affected attribute; it does not add the replaced default attack bonus. Unrelated attributes remain unchanged.

defaults.regenerationUnits: HP or Mana per server regeneration tick; interval not yet defined
